description: A mining automation mod that holds down the left mouse button on your configured hotbar slot. Automatically performs timed sequences including fishing rod swaps and drill rotations. Features a HUD timer, rod auto-detection, and configurable cooldowns. Press K to   toggle, /coalqol to configure. Built for Minecraft 1.21.5 with Fabric.

mods.name: Coal QOL
mods.description: A toggleable auto-clicker with timer-based slot switching functionality

releases.notes:
A mining automation mod that holds down the left mouse button on your configured hotbar slot. Automatically performs timed sequences including fishing rod swaps and drill rotations. Features a HUD timer, rod auto-detection, and configurable cooldowns.

**New Features:**
- Lobby Finder: Automatically searches for lobbies below a configured maximum day
- Configurable maximum day threshold (1-100, default 7)
- Configurable delay between warps (1-15 seconds, default 5)
- Toggle lobby finder with /coalqol lobbyfinder command
- Real-time search status displayed on HUD

**Features:**
- Auto-hold left click on configured mining slot
- Maniac Miner timer with configurable cooldown
- Automatic fishing rod detection and swap
- Optional second drill slot with automatic rotation
- Clean HUD timer display
- Toggle with K key
- Configure via /coalqol command

**Installation:**
1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.5
2. Download and install Fabric API
3. Place the jar file in your mods folder
